# Hermes by Sundartha

> Hermes gives your AI a real phone number. It answers incoming calls, places outgoing calls on the user's behalf and reports back. One remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1): https://app.sundartha.com/mcp

## For AI agents

- [Setup guide for AI agents](https://sundartha.com/agents.md): connect the MCP server, sign-in, getting a number, verifying, placing calls safely, troubleshooting.
